newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss confirm Q3 GDP fell annualised 0.7 percent.
newsitem.headline: Swiss confirm Q3 GDP fell annualised 0.7 percent.

text.p: The Swiss Federal Office for Economic Policy confirmed that third-quarter gross domestic product (GDP) shrank an annualised 0.7 percent compared with the previous quarter.
The data are due for official release on Tuesday, but the office confirmed the number after it became widely known in banking circles.
"I can confirm the growth rate," an office spokesman said, but he declined to reveal any more details until Tuesday, when the data are scheduled to be released around 0700 GMT.
GDP contracted a provisional 0.9 percent in the second quarter.

The office acknowledged last week that it routinely circulates economic indicators under embargo to bank economists and economic institutes ahead of publication to allow them to prepare analysis and analytical commentary in advance.

The information is supposed to be treated as confidential, but the fact that the number was so widely known has prompted the office to reconsider how it disseminates potentially sensitive information.
